draft_en.subject: 5-port industrial PoE switch from ISAF - distributor price for F.A.S.T.
draft_en.body:
Hi Ercan,

We met at ISAF 2025 in Istanbul last October - this picks up what we discussed at the booth.

The 5-port industrial PoE switch you asked about: DIN-rail, 4 x Gigabit PoE+ + 1 x Gigabit uplink, 48 V DC input (so it runs from the MEAN WELL DIN supplies you already distribute), -40 to 75 C, model STI-054GP - distributor price $31.2 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity). The version with an SFP uplink, STI-144GP, is $34.1; the 8-port PoE+ + 2 SFP unit, STI-288GP, is $57.4. CE/RoHS, 3-year warranty with the DIN power supply, neutral packaging or your label.

One question: for your 16-region dealer network, would a first order of 50 units be the right size for a test, or smaller?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
